[LCYC.3.4.1] Cycles that cross a `no` pattern get a more
specific diagnostic because the failure is worse
than a loop — it is an underspecified rule set. The compiler must refuse a
cycle that contains an edge from an `emit` into a `no` pattern ([LCYC.3.2.2])
with `DS_VALIDATE_RULE_DEFEAT`, not `DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE`. A `withdraw` into
a `no` pattern enables its target rather than defeating it, so that edge does
not make a cycle a defeat. What the message names is [LCYC.3.4.2]'s.
